negative_findings.description: None of the six named banks appears to operate a dedicated 'regulatory change / compliance' page that names the driving NBU act. Regulatory drivers surface only incidentally inside tariff and public-offer amendment notices.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches in uk for 'комплаєнс', 'вимоги регулятора', 'вимоги НБУ' on bank domains returned tariff/terms notices and marketing news, not a compliance-notice section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be built around terms/tariff amendment feeds plus regex for regulatory citations, not around a compliance page that does not exist.

negative_findings.description: Bank notices usually state an effective date but not the underlying NBU resolution. The clearest counter-example found is Raiffeisen citing p.17 of NBU Board Resolution No.18 of 24.02.2022 for suspended Western Union transfers.
negative_findings.result_summary: Across PrivatBank, Oschadbank, OTP, Ukrsibbank and Universal Bank notices seen in results, the wording is 'changes to Rules/Tariffs effective from DATE' without a legal citation.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Linking bank action to a specific rule will mostly require inference against the NBU timeline rather than direct extraction; expect a matching step, not a parsing step.

negative_findings.description: Monobank/Universal Bank, and Ukrainian OTP/Ukrsib subsidiaries have no standalone Ukrainian investor-relations page; investor-grade disclosure exists only at parent-group level (RBI, OTP Group, BNP Paribas) or via NBU-mandated reporting.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches surfaced RBI group IR pages but no raiffeisen.ua / ukrsibbank.com / universalbank.com.ua IR section.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The cell's 'IR pages' assumption holds only for parent groups; Ukrainian-entity signal must come from press/notice pages and NBU disclosure instead.

negative_findings.description: Several listing-page URLs (https://www.oschadbank.ua/news, https://www.otpbank.com.ua/about/news/, https://www.universalbank.com.ua/news, https://about.pumb.ua/presscenter/notifications, https://nabu.ua/ua/novini-nabu.html) were inferred from item-level URLs returned by search rather than fetched directly.
negative_findings.result_summary: Item URLs under these paths were confirmed present in search results; the parent listing paths themselves were not fetched in this pass.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The deterministic liveness pass should confirm these listing endpoints and their pagination parameters before crawler configuration.

negative_findings.description: Tariff-change news for state banks (notably Oschadbank) is heavily replicated by low-quality clickbait aggregators (pmg.ua, znaj.ua, tehnofan, ukrainianwall, my.ua clusters) which distort dates and amounts.
negative_findings.result_summary: A uk query on Oschadbank tariff changes returned mostly aggregator rewrites rather than the bank's own notice.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any collection pipeline needs a domain allowlist favouring bank primary sources plus minfin/finclub, or effective-date data will be corrupted.

coverage_gaps.description: Sense Bank, Kredobank, Credit Agricole Ukraine, A-Bank, ProCredit Bank Ukraine and Pravex were not individually searched in this pass; their notice pages likely mirror the PUMB/OTP patterns.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a follow-up uk-language sweep 'повідомлення про внесення змін до публічної пропозиції <bank>' for each remaining top-20 bank.

coverage_gaps.description: In-app and push notifications (monobank app, Privat24, OTP Viber/Telegram) are where many customers actually receive terms-change notices; these are not web-observable.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Consider subscribing to public Telegram/Viber channels of the six banks as a monitored feed, and treat the app channel as an acknowledged blind spot.

coverage_gaps.description: No archival strategy identified for superseded terms versions; banks overwrite PDFs at stable URLs (Oschadbank, Raiffeisen), so historical implementation timing may already be lost.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check web.archive.org coverage for the terms/tariff URLs of each bank and seed the archive going forward via Save Page Now.

coverage_gaps.description: English-language equivalents exist only sporadically (Oschadbank /en/news, en.otpbank.com.ua) and typically omit the terms-change notices published in Ukrainian.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Ukrainian as the system of record; use EN pages only for terminology mapping and parent-group reporting.

coverage_gaps.description: Bank-side responses to NBU consultations (comments on draft resolutions) were not located as a public artefact from any individual bank; only the NABU association channel hints at this activity.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Probe NABU committee minutes/position papers and NBU consultation summary documents for named bank positions.

brief: For Ukrainian systemic and private banks, the observable regulatory-change channel is not a compliance page but the public-offer amendment machinery: dated 'Повідомлення про внесення змін до Публічної пропозиції / Умов та Правил' notices plus versioned terms PDFs. The richest structured streams are PUMB's numbered notifications feed, OTP's 'Повідомлення про зміни' news items, UKRSIBBANK's order-numbered legal_documents PDFs, monobank's date-stamped umovy PDFs and Raiffeisen's 'оголошення' PDFs; PrivatBank and Oschadbank publish equivalent material through their news archives and conditions portals. Effective dates are almost always stated, but the driving NBU act is rarely cited, so bank-side timing will need to be joined against the regulator's own timeline (bank.gov.ua) and interpreted with help from NABU committee coverage and specialist media (minfin, finclub). Principal risks are overwritten terms PDFs destroying history, aggregator noise around state-bank tariff stories, and an in-app notification channel that is invisible to web collection.
